notes: Gold = main sources only (src/main/java). Several tasks target APIs new in 7.0 (core.retry, resilience @Retryable/@ConcurrencyLimit, API versioning) that older model training data cannot answer from memory. `search` is the phrase an agent would derive from the question (English, no identifier the developer did not give). Re-check with `kopt bench spring-framework --verify`.

tasks.question: Where is the core retry loop that backs off between attempts and aborts early when the retry policy timeout would be exceeded?
tasks.search: retry loop back off attempts timeout exceeded
tasks.verifiedBy: Read RetryTemplate.java@v7.0.9: execute() runs the initial attempt, then loops while retryPolicy.shouldRetry, taking backOffExecution.nextBackOff() and Thread.sleep; checkIfTimeoutExceeded(timeout, startTime, sleepTime, ...) preemptively throws RetryException when elapsed + pending sleep >= timeout.

tasks.question: In Spring MVC, where is the API version of a request (header, query parameter...) resolved and then validated before the handler is chosen?
tasks.search: api version request resolve parse validate handler mapping
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v7.0.9: AbstractHandlerMapping.getHandler (webmvc) calls initApiVersion(request), which calls versionStrategy.resolveParseAndValidateVersion(request) (default method in ApiVersionStrategy: resolveVersion -> parseVersion -> validateVersion) and stores an ApiVersionHolder attribute; DefaultApiVersionStrategy.resolveVersion iterates the ApiVersionResolvers and validateVersion throws Missing/InvalidApiVersionException.

tasks.question: Our driver reports SQL state 40001 on deadlocks. Where does spring-jdbc turn that into a CannotAcquireLockException?
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v7.0.9: indicatesCannotAcquireLock(sqlState) returns "40001".equals(sqlState); used by SQLStateSQLExceptionTranslator.doTranslate (line 143, PESSIMISTIC_LOCKING_FAILURE_CODES branch) and SQLExceptionSubclassTranslator.doTranslate (line 86, SQLTransactionRollbackException branch).

tasks.question: Where does Spring AOP decide the execution order of two advices declared in the same aspect?
tasks.search: advice precedence same aspect declaration order comparator
tasks.verifiedBy: Read AspectJPrecedenceComparator.java@v7.0.9: compare() falls back to comparePrecedenceWithinAspect when both advisors come from the same aspect; it uses getAspectDeclarationOrder(advisor) deltas and after-advice inversion.

tasks.question: How does @ConcurrencyLimit throttle method invocations at runtime, and is the limit tracked per method, per class or per bean instance?
tasks.search: ConcurrencyLimit annotation throttle method invocations limit
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v7.0.9: ConcurrencyLimitInterceptor.invoke keys a ConcurrencyThrottleHolder per proxy instance (IdentityHashMap), then one interceptor per method (method-level annotation) or a shared class-level one; Resilience/RejectingConcurrencyThrottleInterceptor extend ConcurrencyThrottleInterceptor whose ConcurrencyThrottleSupport.beforeAccess counts under a lock and calls onLimitReached (block or reject).

tasks.question: How is a method annotated with @Retryable retried at runtime? Which interceptor builds the retry policy and runs the attempts?
tasks.search: Retryable annotation retry interceptor retry policy
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v7.0.9: RetryAnnotationBeanPostProcessor installs RetryAnnotationInterceptor (extends AbstractRetryInterceptor) whose getRetrySpec reads @Retryable into a MethodRetrySpec; AbstractRetryInterceptor.invoke builds RetryPolicy.builder()...build(), wraps invocation.proceed() in a Retryable and runs new RetryTemplate(retryPolicy).execute(...) (reactive return types go through ReactorDelegate).

tasks.question: How does Spring decide whether a @Configuration class is 'full' (CGLIB-enhanced) or 'lite', and where is the enhancement applied?
tasks.search: configuration class full lite proxyBeanMethods enhance cglib
tasks.verifiedBy: Read @v7.0.9: checkConfigurationClassCandidate sets CONFIGURATION_CLASS_ATTRIBUTE to CONFIGURATION_CLASS_FULL when @Configuration has proxyBeanMethods != false, else LITE; ConfigurationClassPostProcessor.enhanceConfigurationClasses collects FULL definitions and calls enhancer.enhance(configClass, beanClassLoader) (line 576).

tasks.question: How does `ExponentialBackOff` compute the next interval (multiplier, jitter, maxInterval, maxElapsedTime)?
tasks.search: ExponentialBackOff next interval multiplier jitter max interval
tasks.verifiedBy: Read ExponentialBackOff.java@v7.0.9: ExponentialBackOffExecution.nextBackOff returns STOP past maxElapsedTime/maxAttempts, else computeNextInterval (initial, then currentInterval * multiplier capped at maxInterval) then applyJitter (jitter scaled by interval/initialInterval, bounded by initialInterval and maxInterval).

tasks.question: In spring-core's concurrent LRU cache, what triggers draining of the buffered read and write operations?
